tools.name: jev_advise
tools.description: Request task-level effort advice or offline retained correlation coverage; both journal sanitized outcomes under ~/.gjc-plugin, not task-quality accuracy

tools.name: jev_check
tools.description: Ask the decision model to check one artifact against one check question; returns a strict correct/incorrect/unsure verdict with confidence and journals a sanitized check outcome. Not verification evidence; no enforcement or correlation-state writes.

tools.name: plugin_metrics
tools.description: One bounded offline aggregate report of the three plugins' retained sanitized journals and Jev's retained v2 correlation state. Strictly read-only: creates nothing, appends nothing, no provider or tests. Missing is not zero; unmeasured is null; descriptive monitoring only, never proof of routing accuracy, task quality or causal benefit.
